description: R0-35-EXIT-PROOF review repair (SEC-R035-3, R035-CR-3): binds the 21 apps/server suites an R0 packet only edited (created before the queue or by a V1 packet) and in which it authored Release 0 cases, which the R0-35 head left in release0-index.json editedOnly and no manifest bound: the identity chain under R0-05 (R0-ID-F1 team-scope-convergence; R0-ID-F2/F3/F4/F5 auth.middleware and identity-password; R0-ID-F4/F5/F7 supabase-admin, including the logout and password sign-out call shape; R0-ID-F6/F6b key-cortex-ws-auth and the gateway's revalidate bound; R0-ID-F7 risc, including 'the cutoffs are written BEFORE the provider is asked'), R0-SEC-01's bootstrap takeover refusal under R0-14 (identity-bootstrap, auth-callback-bootstrap), R0-32 / R0-SEC-03 (D-11) / R0-SEC-04 onboarding-concierge, R0-PL-07 commerce-adapter under R0-11, R0-PL-04 system-actor-authority and R0-20b/R0-20c (job-role-tool-families, money-reports, provider-refund-door, stripe-ops-tenancy SOT-01/02) under R0-20, R0-D1 chart-of-accounts-seeder under R0-16, R0-13d/f/g (contact-enrichment, approval.controller, job-role-policy) under R0-13, and R0-SEC3 public-catalog-projection under R0-02. Every case that passed at the repair head is required (1004 cases), a superset of the cases the R0 packets authored; allowAdditionalCases is true so a later packet may add a case without editing this manifest, while a required case that is renamed, skipped, turned into a todo or deleted rejects the verdict, and a new skip or todo fails release0-proof-coverage.spec.ts (and the runtime check of proof:release0) until scripts/proof-admission/release0-index.json explains it. credit-note-reversal.integration.test.ts stays out: R0-00 only renamed its fixture literals (70f462cc) and authored no case. Run from the repo root: node scripts/proof-admission/run-manifests.mjs --only release0-edited-suites.json (or pnpm --filter server proof:release0 for every Release 0 manifest), against a migrated isolated database and REDIS_URL.
